svg.title: Artha deployment, quality and recovery architecture
svg.desc: Provider-neutral production topology with Gemini as the current provider, release quality gates, privacy-filtered telemetry and browser-side encrypted recovery.

g.text: A small production topology with explicit release, privacy and restore boundaries.
Server-side secrets remain in the API environment; the browser receives public configuration only
Release evidence without financial content in telemetry
Plaintext ledger data never becomes a hosted backup
Decrypt in browser → inspect → explicitly restore
Public browser config only. Secrets remain server-side.
* Current provider: Gemini • no raw financial telemetry
